source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 23 May 1964, p. 1 ("One Magherafelt contest: nominations for Magherafelt Rural Council, with divisions")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations report, Mid-Ulster Mail 23 May 1964 p1 (image read): the only contest is Gulladuff; this candidate 'returned unopposed' (Electoral Law Act (NI) 1962: an unopposed candidate is declared elected).

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. The only contest was for the Gulladuff division, between two Nationalists. Twenty-four unopposed members added from the nominations report (Mid-Ulster Mail, 23 May 1964, p. 1), which names each with the division. 'There was no nomination for the Electoral Division of Swatragh which was previously represented by Mr. J. Harkin'; whether the 1962 rules deemed him re-elected is not confirmed, so Swatragh is not recorded; in 1967 James Harkin is again 'the outgoing member' for Swatragh (Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1967, p. 1) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
